content: OpenF1 official API documents historical sessions from 2023 without authentication; car_data includes brake, drs, n_gear, rpm, speed, throttle at about 3.7 Hz; location supplies approximate arbitrary-origin x/y/z at similar rate and no lateral placement; weather includes air and track temperatures and weather fields once per minute. Existing local f1si cache has none of car_data/location and stores normalized laps/weather only.
